annotations.title: Cash loan prepayment in Poland: shorter term vs lower instalment, early repayment fee (Consumer Credit Act art. 49-50)

description: Use for prepayment or early repayment of a consumer cash loan in Poland (kredyt gotówkowy, nadpłata, wcześniejsza spłata): interest saved with a shorter term vs a lower instalment, the early repayment fee allowed by the Consumer Credit Act art. 50 and when the bank cannot charge it, the refund of the arrangement fee (art. 49) and the net saving. The result also gives the NBP average rate on new consumer loans. Do not use for a mortgage. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Calculate the prepayment of a consumer cash loan in Poland with equal instalments and a fixed rate. Gives the balance after the instalments already paid and three scenarios from today: no prepayment, shorter term (same instalment) and lower instalment (same term), with the interest to the end, the months saved and the new instalment. Gives the early repayment fee the lender may charge under art. 50: only on a fixed rate, only if the contract has a fee, only when the sum repaid early within 12 consecutive months is above 3 times the December average enterprise-sector wage of the previous year (the fee-free threshold is in the result); at most 1% of the amount repaid with more than 12 months left, 0.5% otherwise, never above the interest until the end. Gives the refund of the arrangement fee under art. 49 (linear estimate) and the net saving of each scenario. Default rate: the NBP average for new consumer loans.

amount.description: Loan amount in the contract (principal) in PLN, default 50000.

contract_fee_pct.description: Early repayment fee in the contract, % of the amount repaid, default 1. Use 0 when the contract has no fee.

fixed_rate.description: Fixed interest rate in the repayment period, default true. On a variable rate there is no fee.

months.description: Number of instalments in the contract, default 60.

prepayment.description: Prepayment now in PLN, default 10000. Above the balance = full repayment.

prior_prepayments_12m.description: Earlier prepayments within the same 12 consecutive months in PLN, default 0.

rate_pct.description: Nominal annual interest rate in %, default the NBP average for new consumer loans.

upfront_costs.description: Arrangement fee and other costs paid when the loan was taken, in PLN, default 2500.
